name: Inventory read queries
explanation: Public query operations over the projection: filtered and scoped inventory pages with a separate unresolved page, declared reverse uses and saved selection explanations, all bound to one snapshot.

code.note: Reads the inventory of the Saga snapshot documenting the comparison base; any failure leaves the baseline unknown.
Applies intent and newness filters only to resolvable records and keeps every unresolved candidate on its own page.
Pages declared reverse uses with role and depth bounds and explicit completeness.
Explains every saved implementation Item selection and whether it contributes inherited coverage.
